name: Capivara Booster v2.4.1 (Rust Edition)
notes: - Debloater with real Windows state: the screen queries Get-AppxPackage on load and marks each package as Installed or Removed for real; removed packages get a Restore action that re-registers the app via Add-AppxPackage
- 10 new UWP packages: Copilot, Clipchamp, OneNote UWP, Camera, Alarms, Snip & Sketch, Sound Recorder plus the preinstalled Spotify, Disney+ and TikTok wrappers (25 total)

- Expanded telemetry switch: 10 scheduled tasks disabled (full CEIP: Consolidator, UsbCeip, KernelCeipTask, Uploader, Compatibility Appraiser, ProgramDataUpdater, StartupAppTask, Autochk Proxy, CloudExperienceHost, Feedback/DmClient) on top of DiagTrack/dmwappushservice and ad keys
- Driver Booster opening vendor sites: cmd start misinterpreted URLs containing & and Windows showed a "\\ not found" network path error; the browser now opens via PowerShell Start-Process
- Debloat table rebuilt in the professional style: summary chips (present/removed/total), per-row status and Restore button, Recommended preset

- Debloater com estado real do Windows: a tela consulta Get-AppxPackage ao carregar e marca cada pacote como Instalado ou Removido de verdade; pacotes removidos ganham botão Restaurar que re-registra o app
- 10 pacotes novos: Copilot, Clipchamp, OneNote UWP, Camera, Alarmes, Snip & Sketch, Gravador de Voz e os wrappers pré-instalados Spotify, Disney+ e TikTok (25 no total)
- Telemetria expandida: 10 tarefas agendadas desativadas (CEIP completo) além do DiagTrack/dmwappushservice e chaves de anúncio
- Fim do popup "\\ não foi possível localizar" no Driver Booster: o site do fabricante abre via PowerShell Start-Process
- Tabela do Debloat no estilo profissional: chips de resumo, status por linha e botão Restaurar, com preset Recomendados
